name: tpl-precedence-3-nogoal
task: Do not take the key until you have moved the ball away from the door.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires the agent to move the ball away from the door before taking the key, but the clause does not make the ball move happen. Add a hard Existence to the ball being moved, and keep the hard Precedence(key_lost, blocker_moved). The task is rule-only, but the agent is commanded to move the ball away, so the machine needs a final state.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task commands "Move the blocker before opening the door", but no clause makes it happen. Add a hard Existence(blocker_moved); with Precedence(key_lost, blocker_moved) it also forces key_lost. Also, the task requires "Eventually pick up the target box", but no clause makes it happen. Add a hard Existence(target_picked_up); with Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) and Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) it also forces door_open and has_door_key.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires the agent to move the ball away from the door before taking the key, but the candidate clause is broken. Fix by adding a Precedence from blocker_moved to key_lost, so that key_lost may not happen before blocker_moved.

texts: Do not take the key until you have moved the ball away from the door.
